propositions: select_from_corpus eagerly compiles full ticket state via show_ticket(include_inbound=True) for all ~1957 review-bearing tickets before selection, consuming ~3 hours of CPU time (~5-7s per ticket)
escaped_defect tiebreak in rank sorting requires only close_class and inbound caused_by links, not full ticket state, making eager per-ticket compilation unnecessary
lazy per-ticket compilation is infeasible because escaped_defect unions across all backing reviews (~79% of tickets), not just candidate-referenced tickets
batched ticket index building both close_class and caused_by edges in a single store pass reduces selection time from ~2h15m to ~74s while preserving byte-identical candidate output
the root quadratic is _mentioning_dirs byte-scanning every event file of every ticket per subject during show_ticket calls, inverted by the batched index to one pass building both facts
